name: Unblock Codex Prompt
description: Maintain an agent-scoped Codex base prompt and its model_instructions_file pointer.

agentId.label: OpenClaw agent ID
agentId.help: Only this agent's managed Codex home is modified. Defaults to main.

agentName.label: Agent name
agentName.help: Optional name in the shared prompt. Omit for a generic opening.

frozenContext.label: Frozen context bridge
frozenContext.help: Opt in on OpenClaw/Codex >=2026.9.2 with a supported context-assembly layout. Initial setup requires explicit sync and activation. Local documents and skills stay frozen until another sync.

promptUrl.label: Fleet prompt endpoint
promptUrl.help: Public HTTPS plain-text endpoint with X-Prompt-Revision SHA-256. After initial sync, refreshed daily and when overdue on startup without refreshing agent context. Requires frozenContext; replaces both bundled policy files.

suppressExplicitDelegationPrompt.label: Suppress conflicting Codex delegation policy
suppressExplicitDelegationPrompt.help: Manage a model_catalog_json override, refreshed from the configured provider daily and when overdue on startup. Requires frozenContext and an available provider env_key. Generated-file edits are replaced on refresh.

disabledCodexSkills.label: Codex skills to remove
disabledCodexSkills.help: Plugin names (all of their skills) or exact skill names to disable in Codex's native skills list. Defaults to ChatGPT Pages and Pets. Applied through a managed [[skills.config]] block at startup, sync and daily refresh; other skills are untouched. Set [] to stop managing Codex skills.
